## About
SunCoast Auto And Tire is a car repair and maintenance shop on Haines Rd N in St. Petersburg. We handle auto service, repairs and tires for folks around the neighborhood.
Customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 249 Google reviews. One reviewer wrote that her family has been coming here for years, and another said a friend sent them our way.
Give us a call before you stop by and we'll talk through what your car needs.

## Services
- Car repair and maintenance: Repairs and routine maintenance for everyday drivers.
- Tires: Tire service alongside our auto work. Call ahead to check on your size.
- Lower arm replacement: One reviewer had a right front lower arm replaced the same morning they came in.
